purpose: One entry per (site, aircraft). Pass 4 walks this list, captures screenshot + page text + URL + UTC time + HTTP status for each, and compares against the nearest Internet Archive snapshot to the claim date.
rules: Never log in, never defeat a paywall, never click through a terms gate. A page that requires it is a finding, not an obstacle.
Never trigger a JavaScript alert/confirm/prompt - a modal blocks every further browser command.
Record the URL and the UTC capture time on the page that uses the image.
A site reorganising its URLs looks identical to a site removing an aircraft. Say which you can and cannot distinguish.

targets.note: The aircraft-history table the original claims were screenshotted from. Free tier shows a limited number of past flights; the depth of that window is itself worth recording on each capture.
